old_problem: The Procedure named an exact manufacturing command and three possible terminal states, but Criteria omitted RETEST and the package/spec compatibility, complete virtual-ID scope and exit schema were not project-bound.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits the authorized package hash, board-to-spec compatibility, timeout and expected virtual-ID inventory to be runtime bindings. The explicit command and conservative result semantics are sufficient: only an unfiltered, complete run with an agreed PASS result can pass; FAIL and RETEST are both non-PASS, and RETEST correction/rerun requires separate authorization under ED-11/12. This resolves the Criteria omission without inventing acceptance.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Functionality rows 2289 and 2290, including the exact command, filter options, Criteria and DeepSeek fields.
Read GPT V2/historical record 2409 and retained exact source identity and hashes.
Preserve `./partnerdiag --mfg --run_spec=spec_cx8aas_board_partner_mfg.json` and require package/spec hashes and matching CX8AAS board revision.
Reject tail-only evidence and any unapproved --skip_tests or --test filter because either can conceal missing manufacturing coverage.
Reconcile RETEST as incomplete/non-PASS, never as hardware PASS or automatic rerun permission.
No diagnostic, package installation, filter, log clear or DUT action occurred.

test_case.purpose: Execute the complete approved CX8AAS partner manufacturing specification on the matching board and prove package/spec identity, every required virtual test, complete results and post-run platform health.
required_package: Approved spec_cx8aas_board_partner_mfg.json hash and board/SKU/revision compatibility
Expected virtual-ID inventory and explicit filter/waiver policy
Privileges, dependencies, timeout, artifact schema and health abort/recovery limits
test_case.test_command: Verify the SUT recipe, board identity, package and JSON-spec hashes; enumerate the required virtual IDs and confirm no unapproved filter. Preserve pre-state logs, then from the authorized package directory run `./partnerdiag --mfg --run_spec=spec_cx8aas_board_partner_mfg.json` exactly once with complete stdout/stderr, exit status and result artifacts. Monitor host/GPU/BMC health, reconcile every expected virtual ID and terminal PASS/FAIL/RETEST state, and preserve post-run log deltas.
test_case.expected_result: The exact matching full manufacturing spec executes every required virtual ID with no unapproved skip, all subtests and the terminal result report PASS consistently, output/artifacts are complete, and no unexpected system-health event occurs. FAIL or RETEST is not PASS.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires verified board/package/spec identity, zero unauthorized filter, exact expected-versus-executed virtual-ID equality, complete lossless artifacts, consistent successful exit and terminal PASS, and clean health/log reconciliation. FAIL, RETEST, a missing/skipped test, marker/exit inconsistency, truncated evidence, timeout or health anomaly is not PASS; the end engineer owns the verdict.
safety_gate: Use only the verified package/spec on an isolated maintenance SUT.
Do not use --skip_tests or --test unless a separately approved waiver defines the changed coverage.
Capture full output and monitor host/GPU/BMC health; stop on timeout, crash or approved abort.
Do not auto-correct RETEST, rerun, clear failure evidence or translate tool status directly into a DUT verdict.
expected_evidence: Partnerdiag package and JSON spec version/hash/license/runbook
Expected/executed virtual-ID inventory and filter/waiver attestation
Exact command, full stdout/stderr, exit status and all result artifacts
Pre/post log delta, health monitoring, recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On RETEST, FAIL, timeout, crash, missing coverage or health anomaly, preserve complete evidence and stop. Restore via the approved vendor/platform recovery. Any setup correction, filter change or rerun needs separate authorization and a new evidence set.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure's RETEST is conservatively reconciled as incomplete/non-PASS; Criteria's PASS/FAIL meanings remain unchanged.
